Help-center excerpts:

[fees-schedule-plus-v1] Plus plan fee schedule (effective 2025-01-01)
Here is every fee that can apply to a Plus account, effective January 1, 2025. Fees are taken from your main balance when they're charged and show up in your activity feed with the word "Fee".

| Fee | Amount |
|---|---|
| Monthly fee | $4.00 |
| Out-of-network ATM withdrawal | $2.00 |
| International ATM withdrawal | $3.00 |
| Foreign transaction fee | 1.5% |
| Card replacement | $0.00 |
| Expedited card shipping | $25.00 |
| Outgoing

[fees-schedule-plus-v2] Plus plan fee schedule (effective 2026-03-01)
Here is every fee that can apply to a Plus account, effective March 1, 2026. Fees are taken from your main balance when they're charged and show up in your activity feed with the word "Fee".

| Fee | Amount |
|---|---|
| Monthly fee | $5.00 |
| Out-of-network ATM withdrawal | $2.50 |
| International ATM withdrawal | $3.00 |
| Foreign transaction fee | 1% |
| Card replacement | $0.00 |
| Expedited card shipping | $25.00 |
| Outgoing domestic wire

[fees-schedule-plus-v1] Plus plan fee schedule (effective 2025-01-01)
|
| Expedited card shipping | $25.00 |
| Outgoing domestic wire | $15.00 |
| Outgoing international wire | $35.00 |
| Incoming international wire | $10.00 |
| Cash deposit at a retail store | $3.00 |

## Details

Your first 2 out-of-network ATM withdrawals each calendar month are free. The fee applies from the next one.

No plan has overdraft fees, returned transfer fees or inactivity fees. The monthly fee is charged on your billing date and isn't prorated.

Questions? Our support team is

[close-inactivity] Inactive accounts (effective 2025-01-01)
We may close accounts that have a $0.00 balance and no activity for 12 months.

## Notice

We email you at least 30 days before closing. Any activity during that time, such as a deposit or a card purchase, keeps the account open.

## Fees

We don't charge inactivity fees ($0.00) on any plan.

## Accounts with money in them

We don't close accounts for inactivity while they hold a balance, including money in Savings Pockets.

## Paid plans

A paid plan keeps charging its monthly fee while the account is open, which counts

[close-inactivity] Inactive accounts (effective 2025-01-01)
paid plan keeps charging its monthly fee while the account is open, which counts as activity. If you don't use your account, consider moving to Basic.

## Coming back

If your account was closed for inactivity, you can apply for a new one whenever you like.

## Keeping an account open

Any card purchase, deposit or transfer counts as activity. Signing in to the app on its own doesn't.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[fee-changes-2026] What changed in the March 2026 fee update (effective 2026-03-01)
2 to 3 a month.

## What stayed the same

Basic is still free. Premium is still $15.00 a month with no ATM or foreign transaction fees. Card replacement, wire and cash deposit fees didn't change on any plan.

## Why we made these changes

Out-of-network ATM operators raised what they charge us, and we moved part of that cost into the fee. We lowered the Plus foreign transaction fee at the same time, so Plus members who travel pay less overall.

If the new Plus price doesn't work for you, you can

[plan-fee-refunds] Refunds of plan fees (effective 2025-01-01)
minutes.

## What isn't refunded

Outside the cooling-off period, plan fees aren't refunded or prorated. That includes the month in which you downgrade and the month in which you close your account.

## How to ask

Message support in the app and say you'd like to cancel your paid plan under the cooling-off period. Support can process it for you straight away.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[close-how] How to close your account (effective 2025-01-01)
asks you to confirm.

## Closing through support

Support can close your account for you when the balance is $0.00 and the requirements above are met. If there's money left, move it out first or close in the app, which sends it to you.

## Plan fees

Plan fees aren't refunded or prorated when you close, except under the cooling-off rule for a first paid plan charge.

Closing is permanent. A closed account can't be reopened.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.

Customer question:
I'm closing my Plus account mid-month. Do I get part of the monthly fee back?
